notes: Employees from the 2025 Sustainability Report (HKEX-filed Mar 27, 2026) KPI table 'By Location of Operation' (columns 2024, 2025; the 2025 value is recorded): only two buckets, the Chinese Mainland (837,518) and 'Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan and overseas' (32,104; the 2024 report's bucket was named 'Hong Kong, Macau and overseas'), with no country list, so the second is a region with countries null. Total employees fell from 968,872 to 869,622. Neither the sustainability report nor the annual report gives employees or plants by province or by overseas country, nor a list of domestic production bases with locations. Sites are limited to the HQ (2025 report) and the two overseas car plants the 2024 filings describe as operating in 2024 (Thailand, Uzbekistan), kept on their 2024 HKEX documents, which are still live. The 2025 report also mentions a Cambodia factory groundbreaking (April 2025) and the inauguration of a European headquarters in Budapest (May 2025); these were not added. Uzbekistan factory is BYD UZBEKISTAN FACTORY LLC, listed as a joint venture.
